read_only_open.meaning: Open and project a usable view without creating, moving, repairing, or rewriting a document.

degraded_fallback.meaning: Return a usable but untrusted view with diagnostics and risk-sensitive fallbacks.

proposed_update.meaning: Validate all requested fields as one unit and name only accepted requested canonical fields.

accepted_commit.meaning: With caller consent and a matching revision, atomically patch only requested canonical nodes.

rejected_commit.meaning: Reject an invalid or disallowed update as one unit without a partial write.

conflict.meaning: Refuse a stale revision and leave the externally changed document untouched.

migration.meaning: Apply an explicit reversible shape, version, or location transition only after caller approval.

restore.meaning: Explicitly republish a verified pre-migration backup through conflict-safe atomic persistence.

optional_empty_files.rationale: Rust and Python acquire an empty coordination lock before detecting a stale revision; CXX and Node reject in their approval preflight.
The optional empty coordination lock remains after a rejected apply; all document and backup entries remain exact.
